source.citation: Ogawa Y, Tobinai K, Ogura M, et al. Phase I and II pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic study of the proteasome inhibitor bortezomib in Japanese patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Cancer Sci. 2008;99(1):140-144.
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the PDF text layer; values checked against the extracted Table 3 text. Independent review pending.

relationship_to_model: Not used to build or fit the Lignet 2022 PK model (Hanley 2017 pediatric parameters scaled to adults; PD fitted to Lonial 2005). Different population (Japanese adults) and two doses the model was not fitted to. A comparison is an external consistency check of the PK component.

design.population: Japanese patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma; phase I part (16 patients with PK)
design.administration: Intravenous push over 3-5 s on days 1, 4, 8 and 11 of a 21-day cycle; at least 72 h between doses
design.pk_sampling: Before each dose, and 5, 15 and 30 min and 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 and 48 h after the dose on days 1 and 11 (cycle 1)
design.analysis: Non-compartmental analysis; software, AUC rule and terminal-phase point selection not stated
design.location: printout page 2 (Methods: Drug administration; Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis)

definitions_from_footnote.C0: plasma concentration at the end of administration (estimated value)
definitions_from_footnote.AUC: area under the concentration-time curve from time zero to infinity

1.3.n_note: Table 3 footnote: day 1, n = 7; day 11, n = 5

table3.not_used: Vz and Vss (depend on body size and the unknown terminal-phase method); clearance in L/h (needs each patient's BSA, not reported).

author_interpretation.quote: It can be postulated that CL values on day 1 are apparent values observed due to rapid tissue distribution

not_extracted: Figure 1a (mean concentration-time profiles on days 1 and 11) is an image; values were not digitised.
